conflicts.finding: Mechanical/platform labels such as eCMP/vehicle project code and diagnostic architectures AEE2001/AEE2004/AEE2010 describe different dimensions.
conflicts.resolution: Store diagnostic generation and model/platform scope separately; neither silently implies the other.

conflicts.finding: Routes such as 6A8/688 and 6AD/68D cover many distinct ECU generations/suppliers.
conflicts.resolution: Route reachability triggers identity; decoder reuse requires compatible ECU-family fingerprint.

conflicts.finding: Current project map had D410/D815/D860 from a Fiat 600e Stellantis source; immutable Peugeot e-208 evidence now independently supports the same route/DIDs/formulas.
conflicts.resolution: Add exact e-208 scoped evidence; do not widen to all PSA/Stellantis EVs solely from agreement between sibling platforms.

conflicts.finding: Peugeot iOn/Citroën C-Zero use a Mitsubishi-derived 761/762 service-21 branch unlike mainstream PSA e-208 enhanced UDS routes.
conflicts.resolution: Keep separate platform and local-identifier candidate.
